review_candidates.title: Senior IT Infrastructure & Cloud Architect (m/w/d)
review_candidates.description: Stellenbeschreibung Du bist Teil unseres stark wachsenden Unternehmensbereichs "Defence & Intelligence" am Standort Köln. Zum Kundenstamm zählen neben vielen großen Unternehmen aus dem Rhein-Ruhr-Gebiet auch öffentliche Auftraggeber und Kunden aus dem Verteidigungsbereich. Das gibt dir die Möglichkeit, in verschiedenen Teams und Konstellationen zu arbeiten. Du kannst dein Wissen und deine Fähigkeiten anwenden und vertiefen – und fortlaufend Neues lernen. Als Senior IT Infrastructure & Cloud Architect (m/w/d) verantwortest Du die strategische Weiterentwicklung sowie die Übergabe hochverfügbarer, skalierbarer und automatisierter IT-Infrastrukturen in den produktiven Betrieb. Deine langjährige Erfahrung in der Konzeption und dem Betrieb sicherheitskritischer Umgebungen – insbesondere im Defence- und Behördenumfeld – macht Dich zu einem zentralen Impulsgeber für robuste, regelkonforme und leistungsstarke IT-Architekturen. Bei CGI fördern wir ein vielfältiges, partnerschaftliches und inklusives Arbeitsumfeld. Unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft oder Lebensweg – insbesondere Frauen sind bei uns herzlich willkommen, sich mit ihren Stärken und Perspektiven einzubringen und gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen. Aufgaben Konzeption, Planung und Implementierung hochverfügbarer Server- und Client-Infrastrukturen Entwicklung und Integration hybrider Cloud-Szenarien (On-Premises, Azure, AWS) Auswahl, Bewertung und Einführung neuer Infrastrukturtechnologien zur Erhöhung von Effizienz und Sicherheit Aufbau und Betrieb moderner Virtualisierungsplattformen (VMware, Hyper-V, Container Technologien) Entwicklung und Pflege von Automatisierungsframeworks (PowerShell, Ansible, Terraform) Umsetzung von CI/CD-Konzepten zur Infrastruktur-Provisionierung Aufbau und Betrieb sicherer Identity-Infrastrukturen (Active Directory, Azure AD, Federation Services) Umsetzung von Zero-Trust-Ansätzen sowie Conditional Access und MFA Einführung von Self-Service-Portalen und Governance-Modellen zur Benutzer- und Rechteverwaltung Steuerung des operativen Betriebs unter Einhaltung von ITIL/VSM-Prinzipien SLA-Definition, Monitoring und Berichterstattung Sicherstellung von regulatorischer Konformität, insbesondere in stark regulierten Branchen Führung cross-funktionaler Teams in internationalen Großprojekten Beratung von Fachbereichen, Führungskräften und C-Level-Stakeholdern Etablierung einer nachhaltigen Wissens- und Entwicklungskultur durch Mentoring Qualifikation Langjährige Erfahrung in der IT-Infrastruktur, davon mehrere Jahre in leitender Architektenrolle – bevorzugt mit Führungsverantwortung in sicherheitskritischen oder stark regulierten Umgebungen. Tiefgehende Kenntnisse in: Windows- und Linux-Serverbetrieb, Microsoft Infrastrukturmanagement (SCOM, SCCM, SQL) Virtualisierung mit VMware ESXi, Horizon, Hyper-V Cloud-Technologien (Azure, AWS), Containerisierung Skriptsprachen (PowerShell, Bash), Infrastructure as Code (Ansible, Terraform, Jenkins) Active Directory, Azure AD, SAML, OAuth2, AD FS, MFA ITIL, Agile (Scrum, Kanban), DevSecOps, kontinuierliche Verbesserungsprozesse Deutsch: Muttersprache, Englisch: Verhandlungssicher, auch in sicherheitsbezogenen Projekten WAS WIR BIETEN Bei uns findest du Kolleg:innen, mit denen die Zusammenarbeit Spaß macht. Wir begegnen uns offen, duzen uns über alle Positionen hinweg und denken nicht in Hierarchien oder Silos. Du arbeitest meist direkt an deinem Heimatort – weil wir Kundennähe wörtlich nehmen und uns Work-Life-Balance am Herzen liegt. Du profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und hast je nach Kundensituation die Möglichkeit, von zuhause zu arbeiten. Die richtigen Trainings und Zertifikate bringen deine Weiterbildung voran. Unsere E-Learning Plattform Academia ermöglicht dir das Lernen, wo und wann du willst. Einen Teil deines Bruttogehalts kannst du in CGI Aktien investieren – bis maximal 3 % des Monatsgehalts geben wir für jeden Euro einen weiteren hinzu. Außerdem beteiligen wir dich am Unternehmenserfolg: Du erhältst eine Gewinnbeteiligung, die sich nach deiner individuellen Leistung richtet, sowie danach, wie wir als Unternehmen unsere finanziellen Ziele erreichen konnten. Wir bieten verschiedene Modelle, damit du mobil sein kannst. Sabbatical oder Elternzeit werden unterstützt. Sie sind bei uns kein Karriere-Stopper! Wir sind an deiner Seite, auch wenn es einmal nicht so gut läuft: Du kannst Sonderurlaub nehmen, und unsere Beratungshotline steht dir immer zur Verfügung. Eine Vielzahl an gemeinsamen Events und Freizeitaktivitäten stärkt deine Verbundenheit mit deinen Kolleg:innen. Wir setzen auf Vielfalt, Chancengleichheit und echte Entwicklungsperspektiven – insbesondere für Frauen in der IT- und Beratungswelt mit konkreten Netzwerken, Mentoring und gezielter Karriereförderung! Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action. 1976 gegründet und nach wie vor familiengeführt, ist CGI heute einer der weltweit größten unabhängigen Anbieter von IT und Business Consulting. Ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, Teamwork, Respekt und Zusammenhalt machen das Arbeiten bei uns besonders. Bei uns kannst du dein volles Potenzial entfalten! Du darfst dich vom ersten Tag an als Miteigentümer:in von CGI verstehen. Wir lassen unsere Vision gemeinsam Wirklichkeit werden. Wir profitieren von unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg und haben die Möglichkeit und die Verantwortung, die Strategie und Ausrichtung unseres Unternehmens aktiv mitzugestalten. Deine Arbeit schafft Mehrwert. Du findest innovative Lösungen und stärkst dein Netzwerk aus Kolleg:innen und Kunden. Gleichzeitig hast du Zugang zu globalen Ressourcen, um große Ideen zu verwirklichen, neue Chancen zu nutzen und von der immensen Branchen- und Technologie-Kompetenz zu profitieren. Du bringst deine Karriere voran, da du in einem Unternehmen arbeitest, das auf Wachstum und Langlebigkeit ausgelegt ist. Du wirst von Führungskräften unterstützt, die deine Gesundheit und Zufriedenheit fördern – und dir Möglichkeiten bieten, deine Fähigkeiten zu vertiefen und deinen Horizont zu erweitern.

review_candidates.title: Network Architect
review_candidates.description: Applications Close: Wednesday 16 September 2026 Job Details You'll define, govern and evolve the Australian Criminal Intelligence Commission's enterprise network architecture across on-premises, cloud-connected and hybrid environments, making sure network services stay secure, scalable, resilient and supportable. Working within the Network Operations team, you'll translate business, security and technology requirements into network capabilities, designs and implementation roadmaps. You'll develop architecture patterns and standards, provide technical governance and assurance across projects and operational initiatives, and lead or contribute hands-on to the implementation of complex network capabilities where specialist expertise is needed. The environment is a complex multi-vendor one. The Network Operations team looks after Fortinet security platforms (firewalling, privileged access management, sandbox and management platforms), enterprise routing and switching, network security platforms, load balancing and application delivery, virtualised network products, cloud networking and hybrid connectivity, LAN, MAN and WAN environments, carriage circuits, network monitoring and observability, and network automation and orchestration including Ansible. You'll work closely with business stakeholders, project teams, security practitioners, architects and operational support teams, combining strategic architecture with technical leadership so that network solutions are delivered well and can be supported in operation. Location ACT. Hybrid. Primarily onsite in the Canberra office. Working remotely up to two days per week may be negotiated after six months, subject to approval and the ACIC Home Based Work Policy. Maximum 40 hours per week. Duration 12 months, commencing 16 November 2026, with 2 x 12 month extension options. Citizenship Australian Citizen Clearance NV1. Before commencement you'll need to obtain the ACIC's Organisational Suitability Assessment (OSA). Key Responsibilities * Develop and maintain enterprise network architecture, standards, patterns and roadmaps * Translate business, security and operational requirements into network capabilities and solution designs * Lead the design and implementation of strategic network initiatives and complex technical changes * Produce high-level and detailed network designs and implementation guidance * Act as the technical lead for complex network projects and technology refresh activities * Provide architecture assurance and technical governance across projects and operational initiatives * Define and implement network security architectures in accordance with the ISM, PSPF and Essential Eight * Drive improvements in network resilience, security, monitoring, automation and operational supportability * Guide technology lifecycle management, capacity planning and network modernisation activities * Maintain strong technical knowledge through hands-on engagement with enterprise network technologies * Engage with stakeholders at all organisational levels to develop and communicate technical solutions Skills & Experience * Enterprise network architecture, standards, patterns and roadmaps within large and complex ICT environments * Network security architecture with significant Fortinet experience, including firewalling, privileged access management, sandbox and management platforms, in a multi-vendor environment * Complex network solution design across routing, switching, security, load balancing, WAN and cloud-connected environments * Applying the ISM, PSPF and Essential Eight to network architecture, design and implementation activities * Cloud networking and hybrid connectivity, LAN, MAN and WAN environments and carriage circuits * Network monitoring and observability, and network automation and orchestration including Ansible * Technical leadership, architecture governance and design assurance across multiple concurrent initiatives * Stakeholder engagement and production of high-quality architecture and design artefacts Essential Criteria 1. Enterprise network architecture. Demonstrated experience developing enterprise network architectures and translating them into implemented outcomes within large and complex ICT environments. 2. Network security architecture and Fortinet. Demonstrated high-level expertise designing and implementing enterprise network security architectures, including significant experience with Fortinet technologies and services, within a complex multi-vendor environment. 3. Complex network solutions. Demonstrated experience leading the design and implementation of complex network solutions across routing, switching, security, load balancing, WAN and cloud-connected environments. 4. Commonwealth security frameworks. Demonstrated experience applying Commonwealth security frameworks, including the ISM, PSPF and Essential Eight, to network architecture, design and implementation activities. 5. Technical leadership and governance. Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, architecture governance and design assurance across multiple concurrent initiatives while maintaining alignment with operational requirements. 6. Communication and stakeholder engagement. Demonstrated highly developed communication and stakeholder engagement skills, including the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders and produce high-quality architecture and design artefacts. Desirable Criteria * Azure cloud networking. Experience designing and governing cloud networking architectures within Microsoft Azure environments. * Automation and infrastructure as code. Experience with network automation, infrastructure as code and orchestration technologies. * Zero Trust and architecture governance. Experience with Zero Trust architectures, network segmentation and contemporary security design patterns. Experience supporting architecture governance forums, design authorities and technology standards development. * Certifications and government experience. Relevant industry certifications such as Fortinet NSE/FCP, CCDE, CCNP/CCIE, F5-CA, Azure Solutions Architect or equivalent. Experience in Commonwealth Government or similarly regulated environments. Application Instructions Each candidate must provide a written response to each of the six essential criteria. Each response cannot be more than 3000 characters. Responses to the desirable criteria are encouraged where you have relevant experience. Structure each response using the STAR format (Situation, Task, Action, Result). Sell your capability rather than listing duties: describe the environment, what you were responsible for, what you did and the measurable outcome. Target the specific criterion, for example name the Fortinet platforms you designed and the ISM, PSPF and Essential Eight controls you applied, and quantify scale (sites, users, vendors, projects) wherever you can. If you have worked at the Australian Criminal Intelligence Commission before, include with your application the branch and division you worked in, and your role. Applications close Wednesday 16 September 2026. Apply via the website: https://yolkdigital.com.au/site-data/jobs/network-architect

review_candidates.title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description: Job Description Core Infrastructure Engineering within Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is seeking a motivated Principal Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) who thrives in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving technology environment. The ideal candidate should have experience supporting cloud-scale, highly distributed storage or database services on major cloud platforms such as OCI, AWS, GCP, or Azure. You will be focused on improving service reliability, performance and operability of services used by Oracle OCI Tier-0 services and Oracle customers. You will have your hand on the pulse of the services and will play a key role in responding to live service issues. As a hands-on engineer with strong coding skills. You will debug complex production issues, build automation and monitoring tools. You will have the opportunity to create automation and tooling that will allow us to continuously improve our services. You will own the release certification process by determining whether code is ready for production deployment. In this role, you will be responsible for improving the stability, performance, and reliability of database and storage services which are backbone of OCI. You will collaborate with multiple development teams to identify and resolve cross-functional operational risks by combining engineering expertise, troubleshooting skills, and operational best practices. The role requires a high degree of independence, excellent communication and organizational skills, and a strong commitment to improving customer experience by enhancing service reliability, reducing support tickets, and delivering scalable operational solutions. You will also define and deliver mission-critical services with a strong focus on security, resiliency, scalability, capacity planning, performance management, deployment, and release engineering. Qualifications 8+ years’ experience in Site Reliability Engineering and in storage, networking and database troubleshooting for improving application reliability, scalability, availability Excellent troubleshooting skills for resolving critical production issues in cloud services Expertise in developing scripts (linux scripting), utilities and tools to automate routine or manual intensive tasks Solid experience with CI/CD pipelines, Jenkins and Version Control tools (GitHub, Bit Bucket, GIT) Container administration and development experience utilizing Kubernetes, Docker or similar Solid experience with Configuration Management tools Programming languages development experience using Python, Golang, Terraform Experience with monitoring tools such as Grafana Experience in managing 24×7 high-availability production applications Excellent organizational, verbal, and written communication skills Good understanding of Agile software development principles including using common tools such as JIRA Responsibilities Solve complex problems related to Oracle OCI services and build automation to prevent problem recurrence. Identify opportunities and drive the implementation of automation to improve service health, manageability, reliability and telemetry. Configure, design, and script end-to-end service telemetry, alerting and self-healing capabilities for platforms. Author functional and technical documentation. Serve as part of a 24x7 On Call rotation in support of the infrastructure life cycle Have a professional curiosity and a desire to a develop deep understanding of services and technologies. Educate yourself and others on anything that helps Service Teams more quickly and easily build, test, deploy & run their Services to be more reliable. Identify problems and/or opportunities for improvements that are common across many teams/services and design and implement the solutions. Qualifications Career Level - IC4 About Us Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives. True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs. We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States. Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

Degree in Computer Science or a similar relevant field of studies or completed vocational training as well as several years of relevant on-the-job experience; Knowledge e.g. of IT infrastructure, application management, databases, cloud, network, security, IAM, monitoring or other areas and proficiency at picking up new concepts and technology at a rapid pace; Experience in structuring, presenting and communicating your work results with stakeholders at all levels; Very strong ownership of your priorities, work structure and task management; Proficiency in English. Your future role Design: You create the architecture for our digital services to ensure compliance with our policies and the fit into the Deloitte environment - looking at hosting, network, user access, data retention and all other aspects of solution design including those of sustainable operations. Selection process Apply and create your future with us! If your resume is of interest to us, the recruitment will consist of several stages: Short online interview / short phone interview with Recruiter. Interview/s with member/s of the team. You will receive feedback regardless of process result.

review_candidates.title: Physical Security Operations Specialist I
review_candidates.description: Job Summary: The Physical Security Operations Specialist is considered a crucial and specialist role in the front line defense of Booking.com in protection of their people, customers, partners and assets. The Global Corporate Security team falls within the wider Group Security, Safety and Resilience team: a dynamic, lean team requiring hands-on support in day to day safety and security operations. You will be a part of the team responsible for our enterprise security, focused on operational and procedural security and safety measures. Without these measures, our technical systems are worthless in keeping all Booking.com employees safe and secure. You have a passion for developing solutions, rolling these out and reporting on success. About the role: Promote the use of security & safety response procedures and engage with different tracks to improve reporting skills and quality. Engage and support local teams, including security guarding and emergency response teams in creating physically safe workplaces, and enhance readiness for life safety, physical and environment incidents at the workplace. Review, investigate and evaluate security & safety incidents to give recommendations to improve our security and safety systems and operations. Provide reporting to the Compliance Team in case of significant incidents. Position Corporate Security as a business enabler and a trusted partner for all departments within Booking.com. Transform our office security approach from the legacy methods Booking.com has used for the past 25 years to a modern, forward-looking model. Coordinate and support the implementation of security operations in other offices in close collaboration with Group Security and Regional Security Managers. Deliver event security operations in collaboration with the Group Security team. Work with internal and external stakeholders such as Real Estate and Workplace Services and their safety vendors such as real estate agencies, external project managers and safety suppliers. Add to and roll out global policies. Respond to security incidents if the support of Global Corporate Security is needed when employees or our assets are threatened. Support other security functions in times of high workload such as facilitate set up of security operations day to day activity in new offices. Work as the bridge between Group Corporate Security, the wider Resilience team and the wider security department. Key Responsibilities: Policy, Standards and Governance Ensure Booking.com’s Security Policy, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and Standards are effectively communicated, implemented, and continuously improved across all domains. Communicate all security-related policies and standards to relevant stakeholders, defining clear implementation actions, assigning ownership, and ensuring accountability through structured follow-up and reporting. Monitor and evaluate the adoption of security practices, providing guidance and support where necessary. Monitoring, Reporting, and Metrics Maintain visibility into the effectiveness of security programs through consistent monitoring, performance tracking, and data-driven reporting. Collect, analyze, and interpret key performance metrics from the case management system to assess trends and inform decision-making. Deliver comprehensive quarterly Security Reports to the Leadership Team (LT), summarizing key developments, emerging risks, and progress on mitigation measures. Report relevant intelligence promptly through established internal channels, ensuring leadership remains well-informed on security matters. Collaboration and Stakeholder Management Foster strong collaboration with internal and external stakeholders to ensure a unified and holistic approach to managing security risks. Engage regularly with Group Corporate Security, the Compliance Team, and the Real Estate & Workplace Services (REWS) team on shared initiatives and policy alignment. Maintain active relationships with law enforcement and intelligence partners to facilitate timely information sharing and joint action. Collaborate with the Global Security Operations Centre (GSOC) to exchange insights, collect intelligence, and ensure consistent reporting. Build and sustain a professional network of external security contacts to enhance intelligence gathering and operational resilience. Operational Oversight Oversee daily security operations, ensuring effective coordination between security staff, systems, and procedures. Perform quality controls on day-to-day activities of contracted guards and security suppliers and verify that security systems and technologies function optimally. Collaborate with building management to regularly review the facility’s security posture, evaluate identified risks, and ensure mitigation measures are properly implemented. Support event planning in partnership with the REWS team by assessing proposed security measures, verifying that adequate controls are in place, and confirming that security requests are processed in a timely and compliant manner. Incident Management and Investigations Lead and coordinate the response to all safety and security incidents, ensuring thorough investigation, accurate documentation, root cause analysis and effective follow-up. Respond promptly to incident notifications from the Safety & Security Response Team by interviewing involved parties, reviewing access control and CCTV logs, and creating detailed incident timelines. Develop and recommend improvement or mitigation measures to prevent recurrence, and share findings with relevant domains, including the Compliance Team, to ensure continuous improvement of security processes. Training and Preparedness Collaborate with the Safety & Security Response Team to design, deliver, and maintain training programs on emergency response, incident reporting, and SOP compliance. Conduct periodic drills and exercises to validate procedures and identify areas for improvement. Promote a culture of proactive security awareness by engaging teams across all levels of the organization, reinforcing best practices, and encouraging responsibility for workplace safety and security. Leadership and Professional Conduct Lead by example, fostering enthusiasm and ownership of safety and security initiatives across teams. Exhibit sound judgment, clear communication, and strong decision-making in all security-related matters. Other Group Corporate Security Programs Support or assume ownership of projects and workloads from other security roles as needed, including but not limited to: Security Operations Support for offices beyond Amsterdam, as required Security Awareness Campaigns Event Security Planning and Coordination Physical Security Risk Assessments Travel Security and Safety Management In-site Assessments of offices and facilities Quality Control of Guarding Programs Brief the Group Manager Corporate Security on opportunities to create synergies across all Global Corporate Security programs, ensuring alignment with organizational strategy and operational objectives. B. Skilled: Minimum of 1 to 3 years of experience with strong understanding of corporate security / environmental and physical health & safety operations. Bachelors’ Degree or equivalent in a relevant field (I.E. Security, Resilience). Able to work with real estate and/or building management systems preferred. Understanding of corporate security / security governance bodies / physical safety / investigations / crisis management / risk management experience in a supportive role. General administration / project management skills (writing of plans, tracking). Internal & external stakeholder management skills. Written and verbal communications skills; ability to effectively advise at all levels of the organization. Problem solving mindset, agile thinking. Independent self-starter; detail oriented, organized, and ability to multitask. Ability to identify and apply innovative solutions to complex situations. Able to manage confidential and highly sensitive information with the highest levels of discretion and professionalism. High level of accuracy and strong attention to detail with the right level of interpersonal and analytical skills. Language: English, Dutch Benefits & Perks - Global Impact, Personal Relevance: Booking.com’s Total Rewards Philosophy is not only about compensation but also about benefits. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, as well unique-to-Booking.com benefits which include: Annual paid time off and generous paid leave scheme including: parent, grandparent, bereavement, and care leave Hybrid working including flexible working arrangements, and up to 20 days per year working from abroad (home country) Industry leading product discounts - up to 1400 per year - for yourself, including automatic Genius Level 3 status and Booking.com wallet credit Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) at Booking.com: Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have been a core part of our company culture since day one. This ongoing journey starts with our very own employees, who represent over 140 nationalities and a wide range of ethnic and social backgrounds, genders and sexual orientations. Take it from our Chief People Officer, Paulo Pisano: “At Booking.com, the diversity of our people doesn’t just build an outstanding workplace, it also creates a better and more inclusive travel experience for everyone. Inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. It’s a place where you can make your mark and have a real impact in travel and tech.” We ensure that colleagues with disabilities are provided the adjustments and tools they need to participate in the job application and interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Application Process: Let’s go places together: How we Hire This role does not come with relocation assistance. Booking.com is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We strive to move well beyond traditional equal opportunity and work to create an environment that allows everyone to thrive. Pre-Employment Screening If your application is successful, your personal data may be used for a pre-employment screening check by a third party as permitted by applicable law. Sibelga est le gestionnaire du réseau de distribution d'électricité et de gaz naturel dans la Région de Bruxelles-Capitale. Nous assurons un approvisionnement énergétique fiable et durable à nos clients. Nous visons l'innovation et l'efficacité dans nos services. QUEL SERVICE REJOIGNEZ-VOUS ? Digital Business Solutions (DBS), le département informatique de Sibelga, soutient l’ensemble des activités « métier » de Sibelga. DBS veille à ce qu’elles se déroulent efficacement et puissent se développer, en dotant Sibelga d’un système informatique autonome, évolutif et aligné sur les besoins métiers et les avancées technologiques. Cela est réalisé grâce au développement et à la mise en œuvre d’une stratégie IT centrée sur cinq priorités : Data & IA, Expérience Utilisateur, Cloud & Infrastructure, Sécurité & Résilience et Gestion des Processus & du Cycle de Vie. De cette manière, le département DBS contribue de manière significative aux objectifs opérationnels et stratégiques de Sibelga. Au sein du département DBS, IT Infrastructure est responsable de la conception, de l’implémentation, de la gestion et de l’optimisation de l’ensemble des fondations technologiques IT, telles que les réseaux, les serveurs, le stockage et les solutions cloud. L’équipe garantit la sécurité, la disponibilité et la continuité des systèmes, et réalise les activités de monitoring, de résolution de problèmes et de reprise d’activité en cas d’incident. Elle soutient également les projets, les initiatives d’optimisation et la collaboration avec les autres équipes IT afin de fournir des services stables, performants et efficaces. VOTRE JOB Nous recherchons un IT Capacity Officer capable de gérer de manière proactive les capacités, les inventaires, les licences, les contrats et les ressources datacenter afin de garantir la disponibilité, la performance et la continuité de nos infrastructures IT. Vous jouerez un rôle central dans le dimensionnement, la conformité et l’optimisation de l’environnement technique, en veillant à ce qu’il réponde aux besoins actuels et futurs de l’entreprise. Ce poste polyvalent exige une combinaison de compétences techniques, analytiques et organisationnelles, ainsi qu’une capacité à collaborer efficacement avec les équipes internes et les partenaires externes. Votre rôle s’articule autour de quatre volets principaux , chacun contribuant à la stabilité et à l’évolution de nos infrastructures : Dans le cadre du Datacenter & Infrastructure (10%), vous supervisez la gestion quotidienne des salles informatiques opérées par nos partenaires, coordonnez les activités d’entretien et de maintenance, évaluez les besoins physiques en énergie, refroidissement et capacité de rack, et assurez le suivi des installations, modifications et retraits de matériel. Le volet Capacity & Asset Management (50%) constitue le cœur de votre mission. Vous gérez le cycle de vie complet du hardware et du software, organisez le retrait, la réallocation ou la revente des équipements, et maintenez un inventaire IT fiable tout en alimentant la CMDB. Vous optimisez l’utilisation des assets, gérez les stocks, préparez les budgets CAPEX/OPEX liés aux équipements et anticipez les besoins d’évolution des infrastructures sur 1 à 4 ans en collaboration avec l’équipe Architecture. Vous veillez également à l’application des standards d’équipement et du catalogue IT. Dans le cadre du Licence Management (20%), vous assurez la gestion des licences Microsoft (subscriptions et OnPrem), ainsi que celles d’Oracle, VMware, Apple et autres éditeurs. Vous suivez les acquisitions, renouvellements et retraits, et vérifiez la conformité des demandes et des usages. Enfin, pour le volet Contract Management (20%), vous gérez les renouvellements de contrats de support et maintenance, suivez les engagements contractuels et les coûts associés, participez à la rédaction des cahiers des charges pour les nouveaux marchés et veillez à l’application des exigences techniques ainsi qu’au respect des SLAs par les fournisseurs. VOTRE PROFIL Vous êtes titulaire d’un Master en sciences informatiques, en sciences commerciales avec orientation IT, ou d’un diplôme équivalent par expérience. Vous disposez d’une expérience probante en infrastructures IT, en gestion de capacité, en gestion d’actifs, ainsi qu’en gestion des contrats fournisseurs et des licences logicielles. Vous maîtrisez les environnements datacenter, les processus ITIL, la gestion d’inventaire et de CMDB, ainsi que les modèles de licences Microsoft, Oracle, VMware ou Apple. Vous êtes également à l’aise avec la préparation et le suivi des budgets CAPEX/OPEX et possédez une bonne compréhension des systèmes d’information (virtualisation, stockage, bases de données, systèmes Windows). Sur le plan humain, vous faites preuve de rigueur, de méthode et d’un excellent sens de l’organisation. Vous êtes assertif, capable de négocier et de coordonner efficacement avec des interlocuteurs internes et externes. Votre sens de l’anticipation, votre capacité d’analyse et votre orientation optimisation vous permettent de prendre des décisions éclairées. Autonome, responsable et doté d’une communication claire, vous appréciez le travail en équipe et adoptez une attitude conviviale et professionnelle. NOTRE OFFRE Une entreprise certifiée Top Employer, valorisant le bien-être et le développement de ses collaborateurs. Un job porteur de sens, au service de la ville de Bruxelles et de ses habitants, dans un secteur d’activité en perpétuelle évolution. Une formation de qualité et valorisante, ainsi que des perspectives de carrière. Un package salarial attractif comprenant : Une indemnité de représentation, une prime de fin d’année et un double pécule de vacances, des chèques-repas (10 €/jour presté), des écochèques, un bonus individuel et un bonus collectif. 20 jours de congés légaux et 13 jours de récupération. Une assurance hospitalisation et soins ambulatoires pour le ménage, ainsi qu’une assurance groupe et une assurance accidents vie privée. Une voiture de leasing ou un budget mobilité. Une réduction de 30 % sur votre facture d’énergie. Un smartphone avec abonnement (également à usage privé), un ordinateur portable et le remboursement d’internet. Un fonds social (intervention dans les frais de lunettes, prothèses dentaires et autres frais médicaux, chèque Saint-Nicolas et Noël, etc.).

review_candidates.title: Інженер з програмної та системної інтеграції / Middle Software & Systems Integration Engineer
review_candidates.description: Зарплата (на руки) : від 80 – 160 тис грн, за результатами співбесіди, повністю офіційна Графік роботи: пн – пт, з 9:00—10:00 до 18:00—19:00 (гнучкий початок дня) Оформлення: Офіційний трудовий договір Місце роботи: Київ, р-н Дарницької площі У зв’язку з розширенням технічної команди ми шукаємо Middle Software & Systems Integration Engineer , який має сильний практичний досвід розробки на C++ та системної інтеграції. Позиція передбачає роботу з радарами, засобами РЕР/РЕБ, RF-детекторами, оптико-електронними системами та інтеграцію фізичного обладнання з програмною платформою і зовнішніми C2/C-UAS системами. Якщо ви вмієте працювати з Linux, мережами, протоколами та апаратно-програмними системами й готові розбиратися в нових технологіях — будемо раді бачити вас у команді. Офісний/гібридний формат роботи . Можливі виїзди для інтеграції, тестування та демонстрації обладнання. Основні обов’язки: • Інтеграція радарів, засобів РЕР, РЕБ, RF-детекторів та оптико-електронних систем із власним ПЗ і зовнішніми C2/C-UAS системами. • Вивчення технічної документації, API, протоколів та форматів даних стороннього обладнання. • Розробка на C++ програмних модулів для отримання, декодування, обробки та передачі даних від фізичних пристроїв. • Робота з SAPIENT, ASTERIX та Protocol Buffers. • Перетворення даних між внутрішньою моделлю системи, SAPIENT та ASTERIX. • Робота з потоками даних у реальному часі, багатопотоковою та асинхронною обробкою. • Робота з TCP/IP, UDP, Ethernet, unicast/multicast та мережевими сокетами. • Діагностика мережевого трафіку, контроль втрати пакетів, затримок, таймаутів та відновлення з’єднання. • Розробка та підтримка серверних компонентів. • Робота з REST API та WebSocket. • Документування API, протоколів та Interface Control Documents. • Логування та діагностика програмних і системних проблем. • Робота з Git та CMake, участь у code review. • Постановка технічних задач зовнішнім розробникам, погодження технічних рішень та технічне приймання результатів. • Участь у формуванні системної та програмної архітектури й розробці нового покоління продуктів. Наші очікування: • Впевнене практичне знання C++. • Практичний досвід роботи з Linux. • Знання TCP/IP, UDP, Ethernet, unicast/multicast та socket programming. • Розуміння багатопотокового та асинхронного програмування. • Досвід роботи з мережевими та бінарними протоколами. • Досвід серіалізації та десеріалізації даних. • Знання Git, CMake, API, REST API, WebSocket. • Практичний досвід роботи з Wireshark або аналогічними інструментами. • Здатність самостійно розібрати технічну документацію нового пристрою або протоколу та реалізувати його інтеграцію. • Від 2 років практичного досвіду розробки. • Обов’язковий досвід роботи над реальним проєктом, де ПЗ взаємодіяло з фізичним обладнанням, сенсорами, мережевими пристроями або іншими апаратно-програмними системами. • Англійська — B1–B2 або вище, достатня для роботи зі складною технічною документацією та комунікації із зовнішніми командами. Буде перевагою: • Досвід роботи з SAPIENT та ASTERIX. • Досвід роботи з Protocol Buffers. • Досвід у сферах РЕБ, РЕР, C-UAS, C2, радарів, RF-систем. • Досвід роботи з embedded systems, telecom, robotics, avionics або industrial automation. • Досвід роботи з sensor fusion, track management, GIS або геопросторовими системами. • Знання JavaScript/TypeScript та Vue.js. Ми пропонуємо: • Офіційне працевлаштування. • Оплачувану щорічну відпустку та лікарняні. • Офісний/гібридний формат роботи. • Роботу з сучасними апаратно-програмними системами у сфері defense tech. • Участь у створенні та інтеграції нового покоління продукції. • Професійний розвиток та можливість працювати зі складними технічними рішеннями. • Перспективу розвитку до Technical Lead. Етапи відбору: 1. Співбесіда з менеджером з персоналу. 2. Технічна співбесіда. 3. Практичне завдання із системної інтеграції. Важливо: основний профіль цієї позиції — C++ та системна інтеграція, а не frontend або web-розробка. Не розглядаємо як пріоритет кандидатів, які мають лише досвід frontend/full-stack розробки або C++-розробки без практичного досвіду мережевої взаємодії та інтеграції фізичного обладнання.

review_candidates.title: Senior Manager of SRE
review_candidates.description: Job Description We have an opportunity to impact your career and provide an adventure where you can push the limits of what's possible. The Chief Data & Analytics Office (CDAO) at JPMorgan Chase is responsible for accelerating the firm's data and analytics journey. This includes ensuring the quality, integrity, and security of the company's data, as well as leveraging this data to generate insights and drive decision-making. The CDAO is also responsible for developing and implementing solutions that support the firm's commercial goals by harnessing artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies to develop new products, improve productivity, and enhance risk management effectively and responsibly. As a Senior Manager - SRE at JPMorgan Chase within the AIML Data Platforms and Chief Data and Analytics Team , you will lead a team of 3-7 SRE engineers and scale the AI/ML Data Platform, deliver advanced technology products focused on data and analytics. You will tackle complex cloud data platform challenges, especially around Data Lake Tools. In this role you will work in an agile environment, collaborating with cross-functional teams. Job Responsibilities Leads a team of Site Reliability Engineers and support critical application 24x7 Implements Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) best practices to ensure reliability, scalability, and performance of data platforms. Identifies opportunities to eliminate or automate remediation of recurring issues to improve overall operational stability of software applications and systems. Scale and maintain a managed AWS Databricks platform, and provides engineering and operational support for the platform to Application/Engineering teams. Drives reuse-first adoption of enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to improve reliability operations and customer experience outcomes, with human-in-the-loop validation and appropriate handling of sensitive data. Leads evaluation sessions with external vendors, startups, and internal teams to drive outcomes-oriented probing of architectural designs, technical credentials, and applicability for use within existing systems and information architecture. Drives continuous improvement in system observability, alerting, and capacity planning. Collaborates with engineering and data teams to optimize infrastructure and deployment processes, focusing on automation and operational excellence. Performs platform design, set-up and configuration, workspace administration, resource monitoring, providing engineering support to Data Engineering teams, Data Science/ML, and Application/Integration teams. Executes creative software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or break down technical problems. Develops secure high-quality production code, and reviews and debugs code written by others. Adds to team culture of diversity, opportunity, and respect. Develops and maintains incident response procedures, including root cause analysis and postmortem documentation. Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills Experience with formal training or certification on software engineering concepts. Strong understanding of SRE principles, including SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and incident management. Ability to manage highly technical team of Site Reliability Engineers. Experience leading teams in the safe use of enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment for reliability engineering workflows, including validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity. Ability to set and reinforce organization-level practices for reviewing AI-assisted recommendations and escalating uncertain decisions while maintaining resiliency, security, and auditability outcomes. Extensive experience with AWS, Databricks, or Snowflake platform administration and engineering support is a MUST. Experience with monitoring tools, automation frameworks, and CI/CD pipelines. Proficient in Python application program development with use of automated unit testing. Experience with Terraform development and understanding of Terraform enterprise. Experience in delivering system design, application development, testing, and operational stability. Knowledge of Big Data distributed compute frameworks like Spark, Glue, MapReduce etc. Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills. Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills Multi Region disaster recovery setup, monitoring and testing. Experience in Data pipelines using Spark. Exposure to AWS & Databricks Platform administration. Knowledge of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and orchestration. Familiarity with distributed systems and large-scale data processing. ABOUT US J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives. We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

review_candidates.title: Senior Platform Engineer, Data Platforms
review_candidates.description: About Rivian Rivian is on a mission to keep the world adventurous forever. This goes for the emissions-free Electric Adventure Vehicles we build, and the curious, courageous souls we seek to attract. As a company, we constantly challenge what’s possible, never simply accepting what has always been done. We reframe old problems, seek new solutions and operate comfortably in areas that are unknown. Our backgrounds are diverse, but our team shares a love of the outdoors and a desire to protect it for future generations. Role Summary We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to own the infrastructure, automation, security, and reliability of Rivian’s Data Platform, built on Databricks and AWS. This is a platform and DevOps role at its core: you will treat our data platform as a product, providing data engineers, analysts, and data scientists with a secure, well-governed, observable, and cost-efficient environment where they can move fast without breaking things. You will define and manage the platform as code with Terraform, harden its security posture, build the CI/CD and deployment patterns the rest of the team relies on, and establish the monitoring and observability needed to keep the platform healthy at scale. We value a platform mindset of someone who looks at every solution and asks: “How do we make this more scalable, more secure, more automated, and more self-service?” We don’t believe in manual drudgery. Our team stays ahead of the curve by integrating the world’s most advanced AI tools into our daily workflows. You will have full access to Gemini, Claude and Devin to accelerate architecture design, automate boilerplate, and focus your energy on solving complex platform challenges. Responsibilities Databricks Platform Ownership: Administer, tune, and evolve our Databricks Lakehouse environment workspace configuration, compute policies, serverless and classic compute, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow, and Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs), ensuring it is performant, reliable, and seamlessly integrated with the wider ecosystem. Infrastructure as Code: Design and manage the platform’s AWS and Databricks infrastructure with Terraform, ensuring every workspace, catalog, policy, and integration is reproducible, version-controlled, and deployed through automated pipelines rather than manual changes. Platform Security & Governance: Own the data platform's security posture, including IAM roles and least-privilege access, SSO/SCIM identity management, secrets management, network isolation and private connectivity, encryption, and audit logging. Configure and manage enterprise data governance, lineage, and metadata through Unity Catalog so our data remains a trusted asset. Observability & Monitoring: Build and maintain platform observability, monitoring, alerting, and dashboards for pipeline health, job SLAs, cluster utilization, query performance, and platform costs, using Databricks system tables and our monitoring stack, so issues are caught before users notice them. CI/CD & Developer Experience: Design GitLab CI/CD pipelines, DAB deployment patterns, and paved-road templates that let data engineers ship pipelines and dbt models to production safely and quickly. Champion testing, code review, and environment promotion standards. Reliability & Cost Optimization: Drive capacity planning, incident response, and root-cause analysis for platform issues. Continuously optimize compute configurations and workloads for performance and cost (FinOps). Architectural Influence: Act as a technical consultant within the team, proactively propose infrastructure improvements, evaluate new Databricks and AWS capabilities, and keep our stack at the cutting edge. Collaborative Engineering: Partner with data engineers and data scientists building in Python, SQL, and dbt, supporting orchestration via Databricks Workflows and Managed Airflow, and ingestion via Lakeflow and Fivetran to translate their needs into robust platform capabilities. Qualifications 5+ years of experience in platform, DevOps, cloud, or data infrastructure engineering, including significant hands-on experience operating production data platforms. Deep, hands-on expertise with the Databricks ecosystem: workspace and account administration, Unity Catalog, compute/cluster policies, Databricks Asset Bundles, Lakeflow, Databricks Workflows, and system tables. Other DWH/DataLake/Data Lakehouse platforms experience will be considered a solid asset. Strong experience with AWS infrastructure and services (IAM, S3, VPC/networking, ECS, Lambda) and securing cloud environments or other cloud providers' equivalents.. Proven proficiency with Terraform or CloudFormation for infrastructure as code, ideally including the Databricks Terraform provider, with a strong grasp of module design, state management, and automated plan/apply workflows. Solid programming skills in Python and expert-level SQL for automation, tooling, and platform diagnostics. Practical knowledge of platform security: least-privilege IAM, secrets management, SSO/SCIM, network isolation, encryption, and audit/compliance requirements. Experience implementing observability and monitoring for data platform metrics, logging, alerting, SLAs, and cost monitoring. Working knowledge of dbt and modern ELT patterns, and experience supporting orchestration with Managed Airflow or Databricks Workflows. Experience building CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD preferred) for infrastructure and data workloads. A platform mindset: a track record of proposing and implementing improvements that made systems more scalable, secure, and self-service. Nice To Have Fivetran or similar managed ingestion tools, data quality and monitoring frameworks, Databricks or AWS certifications, and FinOps practices for data platforms. Equal Opportunity Rivian is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law. Rivian is committed to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible for persons with disabilities. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at candidateaccommodations@rivian.com. Candidate Data Privacy and Technology Rivian may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Rivian may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) recordkeeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law. Rivian may share your Candidate Personal Data with (i) internal personnel who have a need to know such information in order to perform their duties, including individuals on our People Team, Finance, Legal, and the team(s) with the position(s) for which you are applying; (ii) Rivian affiliates; and (iii) Rivian’s service providers, including providers of background checks, staffing services, and cloud services. Rivian may transfer or store internationally your Candidate Personal Data, including to or in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and the European Union and in the cloud, and this data may be subject to the laws and accessible to the courts, law enforcement and national security authorities of such jurisdictions. How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process: To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Rivian uses iCIMS Talent Cloud Artificial Intelligence (TCAI) and AI-enabled tools to assist with screening, reviewing, organizing and highlighting profiles and applications that match the key requirements for each role. AI does not make hiring decisions: Qualified candidate applications are reviewed by a member of our team, and all decisions throughout the process are made by humans. We use AI to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment. We are committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable experience for every candidate. Participation in AI profile matching is entirely voluntary. If you prefer that your profile not be used in this process, you can opt out at any time. Opting out means your profile will be excluded from automated matching and will not be surfaced for additional roles through this system. Your current application remains active and will not be affected in any way. Please note that we are currently not accepting applications from third party application services.

review_candidates.title: IT RESILIENCE MANAGER (M/V/X)
review_candidates.description: Titel van de functie IT RESILIENCE MANAGER (M/V/X) Contracttype Onbepaalde duur Werkregime Voltijds WERKEN BIJ SIBELGA, DAT BOOST MIJN ENERGIE ! Sibelga is de distributienetbeheerder voor elektriciteit en aardgas in het Brussels Hoofdstedelijk Gewest. Wij zorgen voor een bedrijfszekere en duurzame energiebevoorrading van onze klanten. Wij streven in onze diensten vernieuwing en efficiëntie na. BIJ WELKE DIENST KOM JE TERECHT? De afdeling Digital Business Solutions (DBS) ondersteunt alle businessactiviteiten van Sibelga. Het zorgt ervoor dat Sibelga beschikt over performante processen en een autonoom IT-systeem dat deze processen ondersteunt en dat afgestemd is op de evoluerende behoeften en opkomende technologieën. Binnen de afdeling DBS is de eenheid IT Service Management - ERP - Tranest opgebouwd rond drie polen: Applicaties / Projecten Het ERP-team is verantwoordelijk voor de applicaties die essentieel zijn voor de interne werking van het bedrijf (Financiën, Logistiek, Human Resources), voornamelijk via de SAP-suite en aanverwante applicaties. Het zorgt voor de ontwikkeling ervan en biedt tweedelijnsondersteuning in geval van incidenten. Operationeel / Ondersteuning Het User Support & IMAC-team beheert eerstelijnsincidenten via de Service Desk, biedt directe ondersteuning aan gebruikers en zorgt voor de levering en het beheer van de IT-apparatuur die nodig is voor het dagelijks gebruik van de applicaties. Enabler / Governance De teams Transition Management en Test Management begeleiden de transversale processen voor de hele IT-afdeling. Ze implementeren methodologieën op het gebied van Change & Release Management, Configuration Management, Demand Management en Testing Management om een soepele overgang van ontwikkeling naar productie te garanderen. Binnen deze eenheid zijn we op zoek naar een IT Resilience Manager die rechtstreeks rapporteert aan de Unit Manager. JOUW JOB Als IT Resilience Manager speel je een cruciale rol in het waarborgen van de continuïteit van de bedrijfsactiviteiten en van een effectief beheer van incidenten. De rollen omvatten de coördinatie van ernstige incidenten, het beheer van problemen en het beheer van het rampherstelplan. Als coördinator van ernstige incidenten ben je verantwoordelijk voor het beheer en de coördinatie van ernstige IT-incidenten (gemiddeld 10 ernstige incidenten per jaar) die van invloed zijn op kritieke bedrijfsdiensten. Je zorgt voor effectieve communicatie tussen technische teams, zakelijke stakeholders en het management, terwijl je werk maakt van een snel herstel van de dienstverlening (incidentoplossing) en structurele aanpassingen (probleemoplossing). Wanneer een ernstig incident wordt gedetecteerd, start en beheer je het proces voor ernstige incidenten: Oprichting van een taskforce met de specifieke middelen die nodig zijn voor het onderzoek en de probleemoplossing. De taskforce aansturen om het incident zo snel mogelijk op te lossen. Communiceren met gebruikers en stakeholders via overeengekomen kanalen, zo snel mogelijk na de detectie van het incident en regelmatig tot het opgelost is. Als verantwoordelijke voor de verandering de veranderingen organiseren (beheer van veranderingsaanvragen – goedkeuring door de CAB – organisatie van de implementatie) Het incident documenteren volgens het overeengekomen proces, de analyse na het incident in goede banen leiden en voor de documentatie in ITSM-tools zorgen. De definitie en oplossing van het probleem aansturen. Als probleembeheerder ben je verantwoordelijk voor het beheer van het proces voor het beheer van problemen . Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp, de implementatie, het beheer en de voortdurende verbetering van het proces. Hoewel dit proces al vastligt, wordt het niet consistent toegepast binnen de organisatie. Daarom is een volledige evaluatie en herziening van het proces nodig om de afstemming, efficiëntie en consistentie te waarborgen. Als beheerder van het rampherstelplan ben je verantwoordelijk voor de planning, de implementatie en de handhaving van maatregelen die het herstel van de systemen en gegevens garanderen wanneer zich een ramp voordoet. Deze rol omvat de identificatie van potentiële risico's, de ontwikkeling van noodplannen en het testen van die plannen om hun effectiviteit te garanderen. Je werkt nauw samen met verschillende diensten om ervoor te zorgen dat de bedrijfsactiviteiten na een ramp snel en efficiënt kunnen worden hervat, waarbij downtime en/of gegevensverlies tot een minimum worden beperkt. JOUW PROFIEL Universitair diploma op masterniveau: burgerlijk of industrieel ingenieur of informatica/technologie. Opleiding in risicobeoordeling, crisisbeheer en noodplanning. Minimaal 5 tot 10 jaar ervaring in een belangrijke technische en operationele context of in een complexe IT-afdeling. Beroepservaring in het beheer van IT-activiteiten, met bijzondere aandacht voor incidentbeheer en veerkracht. Goed begrip van IT-infrastructuur, beveiligingsprotocollen en maatregelen voor gegevensback-up en -herstel. Vermogen om de verbanden tussen bedrijfsapplicaties en IT-infrastructuur te begrijpen. Sterke analytische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden. Goed ontwikkelde communicatieve en leiderschapsvaardigheden. Ervaring als IT-incidentmanager is een pluspunt. ONS AANBOD Een Top Employer-gecertificeerd bedrijf, dat het welzijn en de ontwikkeling van zijn medewerkers waardeert. Een betekenisvolle job, ten dienste van de stad en haar inwoners, in een sector die voortdurend evolueert. Een degelijke, voldoening gevende opleiding, plus doorgroeimogelijkheden. Een aantrekkelijk loonpakket met: Een representatievergoeding, eindejaarspremie en dubbel vakantiegeld, maaltijdcheques (€10/werkdag), ecocheques, individuele bonus en collectieve bonus. 20 wettelijke vakantiedagen en 13 compensatie-dagen. Hospitalisatieverzekering en ambulante zorgen voor het gezin, alsook een groepsverzekering en ongevallenverzekering privéleven. Een leasingwagen of mobiliteitsbudget. Korting van 30% op je energiefactuur. Smartphone met abonnement (ook voor privégebruik), laptop en terugbetaling internet. Sociaal fonds (tussenkomst in kosten voor bril, tandprothese, en andere medische kosten, Sinterklaas- & Kerstcheque, enz.). Locatie Locatie Werkhuizenkaai 16, 1000 Brussel

Maintain project budgets and regularly report on expenditure, commitments, variances, contingencies and anticipated final costs. Develop appropriate procurement strategies for construction works, consultants and other project-related services. Prepare, coordinate and issue tender documentation, including scopes of work, pricing schedules and commercial requirements. Manage tender clarifications and evaluate commercial submissions. Lead commercial negotiations and prepare tender adjudication reports and contract award recommendations. Administer construction, consultancy and supply contracts throughout the project lifecycle. Monitor contractual obligations and manage instructions, variations, claims, extensions of time and other commercial matters. Receive and review contractors’ applications for payment and supporting documentation. Coordinate with appointed Quantity Surveyors to verify completed works, quantities, variations and amounts claimed. Review and approve payment certificates and contractor payment recommendations in accordance with PB’s delegated authority procedures. Monitor project expenditure and cost-to-complete positions, identifying and reporting potential overruns at an early stage. Support value-engineering and cost-optimisation exercises while protecting the project’s quality and commercial objectives. Maintain complete and accurate procurement, contractual, cost and payment records. Prepare regular cost reports, commercial updates and decision papers for management and other stakeholders. Liaise with project managers, architects, engineers, consultants, contractors, Finance, Legal and other internal and external stakeholders. Manage contract close-out and the agreement of final accounts. Requirements and Skills A minimum of five years of relevant experience in quantity surveying, cost management or commercial management within real estate development or construction. A bachelor’s degree in Quantity Surveying, Construction Economics, Commercial Management, Civil Engineering or a related discipline. Demonstrable experience preparing and managing construction budgets, cost plans, forecasts and cost-to-complete reports. Strong experience in procurement, tender preparation, tender evaluation, commercial negotiation and contract award. Practical knowledge of construction contract administration, including variations, claims and final accounts. Experience reviewing payment applications and administering payment-certification procedures. Strong understanding of Bills of Quantities, construction drawings, specifications and pricing documentation. Working knowledge of recognised forms of construction contract, such as FIDIC or equivalent forms. Strong financial, analytical and commercial judgement, with excellent attention to detail. Strong negotiation, written communication and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to prepare clear cost reports, tender adjudications and commercial recommendations. Ability to manage external Quantity Surveyors and other professional advisers effectively. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with relevant cost-management or project-reporting systems. Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities in a structured and accountable manner. High level of initiative and a proactive, methodical working style. Ability to collaborate effectively within a small, high-performing team environment. Experience working for a real estate developer, investment manager or development-management business would be considered an advantage. Knowledge of the Maltese construction market and local procurement practices would be considered an advantage. The salary for this position will be commensurate with qualifications, experience and skills. If you are commercially astute, methodical, have an excellent eye for detail and are looking for a challenging yet rewarding opportunity that will enable you to grow and develop professionally, we encourage you to apply by filling in the form below.

You'll work closely with business stakeholders, project teams, security practitioners, architects and operational support teams, combining strategic architecture with technical leadership so that network solutions are delivered well and can be supported in operation. Location ACT. Hybrid. Primarily onsite in the Canberra office. Working remotely up to two days per week may be negotiated after six months, subject to approval and the ACIC Home Based Work Policy. Maximum 40 hours per week. Duration 12 months, commencing 16 November 2026, with 2 x 12 month extension options. Citizenship Australian Citizen Clearance NV1. Before commencement you'll need to obtain the ACIC's Organisational Suitability Assessment (OSA). Key Responsibilities * Develop and maintain enterprise network architecture, standards, patterns and roadmaps * Translate business, security and operational requirements into network capabilities and solution designs * Lead the design and implementation of strategic network initiatives and complex technical changes * Produce high-level and detailed network designs and implementation guidance * Act as the technical lead for complex network projects and technology refresh activities * Provide architecture assurance and technical governance across projects and operational initiatives * Define and implement network security architectures in accordance with the ISM, PSPF and Essential Eight * Drive improvements in network resilience, security, monitoring, automation and operational supportability * Guide technology lifecycle management, capacity planning and network modernisation activities * Maintain strong technical knowledge through hands-on engagement with enterprise network technologies * Engage with stakeholders at all organisational levels to develop and communicate technical solutions Skills & Experience * Enterprise network architecture, standards, patterns and roadmaps within large and complex ICT environments * Network security architecture with significant Fortinet experience, including firewalling, privileged access management, sandbox and management platforms, in a multi-vendor environment * Complex network solution design across routing, switching, security, load balancing, WAN and cloud-connected environments * Applying the ISM, PSPF and Essential Eight to network architecture, design and implementation activities * Cloud networking and hybrid connectivity, LAN, MAN and WAN environments and carriage circuits * Network monitoring and observability, and network automation and orchestration including Ansible * Technical leadership, architecture governance and design assurance across multiple concurrent initiatives * Stakeholder engagement and production of high-quality architecture and design artefacts Essential Criteria 1. Enterprise network architecture. Demonstrated experience developing enterprise network architectures and translating them into implemented outcomes within large and complex ICT environments. 2. Network security architecture and Fortinet. Demonstrated high-level expertise designing and implementing enterprise network security architectures, including significant experience with Fortinet technologies and services, within a complex multi-vendor environment. 3. Complex network solutions. Demonstrated experience leading the design and implementation of complex network solutions across routing, switching, security, load balancing, WAN and cloud-connected environments. 4. Commonwealth security frameworks. Demonstrated experience applying Commonwealth security frameworks, including the ISM, PSPF and Essential Eight, to network architecture, design and implementation activities. 5. Technical leadership and governance. Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, architecture governance and design assurance across multiple concurrent initiatives while maintaining alignment with operational requirements. 6. Communication and stakeholder engagement. Demonstrated highly developed communication and stakeholder engagement skills, including the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders and produce high-quality architecture and design artefacts. Desirable Criteria * Azure cloud networking. Experience designing and governing cloud networking architectures within Microsoft Azure environments. * Automation and infrastructure as code. Experience with network automation, infrastructure as code and orchestration technologies. * Zero Trust and architecture governance. Experience with Zero Trust architectures, network segmentation and contemporary security design patterns. Experience supporting architecture governance forums, design authorities and technology standards development. * Certifications and government experience. Relevant industry certifications such as Fortinet NSE/FCP, CCDE, CCNP/CCIE, F5-CA, Azure Solutions Architect or equivalent. Experience in Commonwealth Government or similarly regulated environments. Application Instructions Each candidate must provide a written response to each of the six essential criteria. Each response cannot be more than 3000 characters. Responses to the desirable criteria are encouraged where you have relevant experience. Structure each response using the STAR format (Situation, Task, Action, Result). Target the specific criterion, for example name the Fortinet platforms you designed and the ISM, PSPF and Essential Eight controls you applied, and quantify scale (sites, users, vendors, projects) wherever you can. If you have worked at the Australian Criminal Intelligence Commission before, include with your application the branch and division you worked in, and your role. Sibelga est le gestionnaire du réseau de distribution d'électricité et de gaz naturel dans la Région de Bruxelles-Capitale. Nous assurons un approvisionnement énergétique fiable et durable à nos clients. Nous visons l'innovation et l'efficacité dans nos services. QUEL SERVICE REJOIGNEZ-VOUS ? Digital Business Solutions (DBS), le département informatique de Sibelga, soutient l’ensemble des activités « métier » de Sibelga. DBS veille à ce qu’elles se déroulent efficacement et puissent se développer, en dotant Sibelga d’un système informatique autonome, évolutif et aligné sur les besoins métiers et les avancées technologiques. Cela est réalisé grâce au développement et à la mise en œuvre d’une stratégie IT centrée sur cinq priorités : Data & IA, Expérience Utilisateur, Cloud & Infrastructure, Sécurité & Résilience et Gestion des Processus & du Cycle de Vie. De cette manière, le département DBS contribue de manière significative aux objectifs opérationnels et stratégiques de Sibelga. Au sein du département DBS, IT Infrastructure est responsable de la conception, de l’implémentation, de la gestion et de l’optimisation de l’ensemble des fondations technologiques IT, telles que les réseaux, les serveurs, le stockage et les solutions cloud. L’équipe garantit la sécurité, la disponibilité et la continuité des systèmes, et réalise les activités de monitoring, de résolution de problèmes et de reprise d’activité en cas d’incident. Elle soutient également les projets, les initiatives d’optimisation et la collaboration avec les autres équipes IT afin de fournir des services stables, performants et efficaces. VOTRE JOB Nous recherchons un IT Capacity Officer capable de gérer de manière proactive les capacités, les inventaires, les licences, les contrats et les ressources datacenter afin de garantir la disponibilité, la performance et la continuité de nos infrastructures IT. Vous jouerez un rôle central dans le dimensionnement, la conformité et l’optimisation de l’environnement technique, en veillant à ce qu’il réponde aux besoins actuels et futurs de l’entreprise. Ce poste polyvalent exige une combinaison de compétences techniques, analytiques et organisationnelles, ainsi qu’une capacité à collaborer efficacement avec les équipes internes et les partenaires externes. Votre rôle s’articule autour de quatre volets principaux , chacun contribuant à la stabilité et à l’évolution de nos infrastructures : Dans le cadre du Datacenter & Infrastructure (10%), vous supervisez la gestion quotidienne des salles informatiques opérées par nos partenaires, coordonnez les activités d’entretien et de maintenance, évaluez les besoins physiques en énergie, refroidissement et capacité de rack, et assurez le suivi des installations, modifications et retraits de matériel. Le volet Capacity & Asset Management (50%) constitue le cœur de votre mission. Vous gérez le cycle de vie complet du hardware et du software, organisez le retrait, la réallocation ou la revente des équipements, et maintenez un inventaire IT fiable tout en alimentant la CMDB. Vous optimisez l’utilisation des assets, gérez les stocks, préparez les budgets CAPEX/OPEX liés aux équipements et anticipez les besoins d’évolution des infrastructures sur 1 à 4 ans en collaboration avec l’équipe Architecture. Vous veillez également à l’application des standards d’équipement et du catalogue IT. Dans le cadre du Licence Management (20%), vous assurez la gestion des licences Microsoft (subscriptions et OnPrem), ainsi que celles d’Oracle, VMware, Apple et autres éditeurs. Vous suivez les acquisitions, renouvellements et retraits, et vérifiez la conformité des demandes et des usages. Our customers and their mission are the center of what we do.
