new_matches.title: Інженер з програмної та системної інтеграції / Middle Software & Systems Integration Engineer
new_matches.description: Зарплата (на руки) : від 80 – 160 тис грн, за результатами співбесіди, повністю офіційна Графік роботи: пн – пт, з 9:00—10:00 до 18:00—19:00 (гнучкий початок дня) Оформлення: Офіційний трудовий договір Місце роботи: Київ, р-н Дарницької площі У зв’язку з розширенням технічної команди ми шукаємо Middle Software & Systems Integration Engineer , який має сильний практичний досвід розробки на C++ та системної інтеграції. Позиція передбачає роботу з радарами, засобами РЕР/РЕБ, RF-детекторами, оптико-електронними системами та інтеграцію фізичного обладнання з програмною платформою і зовнішніми C2/C-UAS системами. Якщо ви вмієте працювати з Linux, мережами, протоколами та апаратно-програмними системами й готові розбиратися в нових технологіях — будемо раді бачити вас у команді. Офісний/гібридний формат роботи . Можливі виїзди для інтеграції, тестування та демонстрації обладнання. Основні обов’язки: • Інтеграція радарів, засобів РЕР, РЕБ, RF-детекторів та оптико-електронних систем із власним ПЗ і зовнішніми C2/C-UAS системами. • Вивчення технічної документації, API, протоколів та форматів даних стороннього обладнання. • Розробка на C++ програмних модулів для отримання, декодування, обробки та передачі даних від фізичних пристроїв. • Робота з SAPIENT, ASTERIX та Protocol Buffers. • Перетворення даних між внутрішньою моделлю системи, SAPIENT та ASTERIX. • Робота з потоками даних у реальному часі, багатопотоковою та асинхронною обробкою. • Робота з TCP/IP, UDP, Ethernet, unicast/multicast та мережевими сокетами. • Діагностика мережевого трафіку, контроль втрати пакетів, затримок, таймаутів та відновлення з’єднання. • Розробка та підтримка серверних компонентів. • Робота з REST API та WebSocket. • Документування API, протоколів та Interface Control Documents. • Логування та діагностика програмних і системних проблем. • Робота з Git та CMake, участь у code review. • Постановка технічних задач зовнішнім розробникам, погодження технічних рішень та технічне приймання результатів. • Участь у формуванні системної та програмної архітектури й розробці нового покоління продуктів. Наші очікування: • Впевнене практичне знання C++. • Практичний досвід роботи з Linux. • Знання TCP/IP, UDP, Ethernet, unicast/multicast та socket programming. • Розуміння багатопотокового та асинхронного програмування. • Досвід роботи з мережевими та бінарними протоколами. • Досвід серіалізації та десеріалізації даних. • Знання Git, CMake, API, REST API, WebSocket. • Практичний досвід роботи з Wireshark або аналогічними інструментами. • Здатність самостійно розібрати технічну документацію нового пристрою або протоколу та реалізувати його інтеграцію. • Від 2 років практичного досвіду розробки. • Обов’язковий досвід роботи над реальним проєктом, де ПЗ взаємодіяло з фізичним обладнанням, сенсорами, мережевими пристроями або іншими апаратно-програмними системами. • Англійська — B1–B2 або вище, достатня для роботи зі складною технічною документацією та комунікації із зовнішніми командами. Буде перевагою: • Досвід роботи з SAPIENT та ASTERIX. • Досвід роботи з Protocol Buffers. • Досвід у сферах РЕБ, РЕР, C-UAS, C2, радарів, RF-систем. • Досвід роботи з embedded systems, telecom, robotics, avionics або industrial automation. • Досвід роботи з sensor fusion, track management, GIS або геопросторовими системами. • Знання JavaScript/TypeScript та Vue.js. Ми пропонуємо: • Офіційне працевлаштування. • Оплачувану щорічну відпустку та лікарняні. • Офісний/гібридний формат роботи. • Роботу з сучасними апаратно-програмними системами у сфері defense tech. • Участь у створенні та інтеграції нового покоління продукції. • Професійний розвиток та можливість працювати зі складними технічними рішеннями. • Перспективу розвитку до Technical Lead. Етапи відбору: 1. Співбесіда з менеджером з персоналу. 2. Технічна співбесіда. 3. Практичне завдання із системної інтеграції. Важливо: основний профіль цієї позиції — C++ та системна інтеграція, а не frontend або web-розробка. Не розглядаємо як пріоритет кандидатів, які мають лише досвід frontend/full-stack розробки або C++-розробки без практичного досвіду мережевої взаємодії та інтеграції фізичного обладнання.

Invest in us and we’ll invest in you. Job Description Purpose of role Drive AWS infrastructure and application migration waves from initial design through to execution, ensuring technical solutions are robust and aligned with programme objectives. Discovery work is a critical part of this role, so candidates must demonstrate strong experience here. Key Responsibilities Lead the end to end design of AWS migration solutions, covering both infrastructure and application layers. Run discovery exercises using tools such as AWS Application Discovery Service or AWS Migration Hub to assess current state environments, dependencies, and risks ahead of migration. Translate discovery findings into AWS migration designs and wave plans, selecting appropriate migration strategies (rehost, replatform, refactor) for each workload. Design target state architectures on AWS, covering compute, storage, networking, and security. Work alongside delivery and project managers to align technical approach with programme timelines. Support execution of migration waves using tools such as AWS MGN, DMS, or Application Migration Service, resolving technical issues as they arise. Produce architecture documentation and design artefacts to support governance and sign off. Liaise with security, change, and transition teams to ensure migration designs meet organisational and AWS Well Architected requirements. Qualifications Required experience Proven track record driving AWS migration waves from design through execution. Strong AWS infrastructure experience, including VPC design, EC2, networking, and storage services. Strong application experience, including understanding of application dependencies and integration points within AWS environments. Hands on discovery experience is essential, this is not optional for the role. Experience working across multiple migration waves in a programme setting. Working knowledge of AWS migration tooling (MGN, DMS, Application Discovery Service, Migration Hub). Desirable Experience AWS certification (Solutions Architect Associate or Professional preferred). Experience working within large scale transformation or migration programmes. Familiarity with AWS Well Architected Framework. Familiarity with governance frameworks and change processes (RFCs, RAID logs). Skills And Attributes Strong analytical and problem solving skills. Ability to communicate technical detail clearly to both technical and non technical stakeholders. Comfortable working under pressure across multiple concurrent workstreams. Strong documentation skills. Additional Information At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability. Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes. And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more. Version 1 is an equal opportunities employer We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued and able to thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences, and we value the different perspectives people bring including those shaped by disability and neurodiversity.

new_matches.title: IT Manager
new_matches.description: Quandela stands as a global leader in quantum computing, driven by groundbreaking technology and a strategic vision for scaling quantum solutions. The company's unique ability to offer both hardware and software solutions, along with its commitment to build energy efficient quantum processing units that scale, positions it to play a key role in the next wave of innovation, and in many strategic and sovereign industrial sectors. With a team of more than 140 people, we develop our own hardware and software stack, from semiconductor quantum emitters and photonic processors to quantum control systems and quantum algorithms. Our ambition is to build large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of solving problems beyond the reach of classical computation using Quandela's cutting-edge quantum dot technology. This role ensures system reliability, data integrity, and compliance with applicable regulatory standards while enabling efficient document and data management across functions such as Quality, Clinical, and Regulatory. The administrator acts as a key liaison between business users and IT, translating operational needs into scalable system solutions that enhance productivity, maintain compliance, and support organizational goals. Key Responsibilities System Administration & Configuration Administer and maintain Veeva Vault applications (e.g., CTMS, eTMF, RIM). Configure workflows, lifecycles, document types, security settings, and metadata. Manage user roles, permissions, and access controls. User Support & Training Provide day-to-day support for end users, troubleshooting issues and resolving system errors. Develop and deliver training materials and sessions for new and existing users. Act as the primary point of contact for Vault-related inquiries. Release & Change Management Support Veeva Vault quarterly releases, including impact assessments, testing, and deployment. Manage system updates, enhancements, and change requests. Coordinate validation activities in regulated environments. Validation & Compliance Ensure system compliance with GxP and other regulatory standards. Support validation documentation (IQ/OQ/PQ), audits, and inspections. Maintain audit trails and ensure data integrity. Data & Document Management Oversee document lifecycle management, including version control and archival. Ensure data quality, consistency, and governance within the system. Support data migrations and integrations with other systems. Integration & Technical Support Collaborate with IT teams to manage integrations (APIs, middleware, etc.). Assist in troubleshooting system integrations and performance issues. Reporting & Continuous Improvement Develop and maintain reports and dashboards. Identify opportunities to improve system efficiency and user experience. Recommend and implement best practices Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Life Sciences, or a related field. 4+ years of experience administering Veeva Vault (CLINICAL OPERATIONS) or similar content management systems. Certified in Veeva Vault Strong understanding of document management processes in regulated industries. Experience with system configuration, workflows, and security models. Familiarity with GxP, FDA, or EMA regulatory requirements. What We Offer We provide a competitive compensation package, comprehensive benefits and the opportunity for personal and professional growth in a rewarding environment. As a full-service, global Contract Research Organization (CRO), we build solution-driven teams working towards a healthier future. Operating with the autonomy of a regional owner, you will expand Spire’s market presence across key industry segments, leverage our partner ecosystem to drive adoption of our forecast data, APIs, and decision-support solutions, and consistently exceed sales targets. This is a high-impact, quota-carrying role for a seller who is energized by how data and software are reshaping traditional industries and who wants to sell a product that is, quite literally, powered by space. What You Will Do: Own a territory: Build and execute a territory plan spanning EMEA and APAC, identifying and developing new business opportunities while growing and retaining existing client accounts. Exceed targets: Meet and surpass assigned quotas through disciplined prospecting, qualification, and full-cycle deal execution. Build lasting relationships: Develop strong, long-term relationships with key clients, partners, and stakeholders across the weather, climate, and earth intelligence ecosystem — understanding their needs, challenges, and objectives to tailor solutions accordingly. Sell consultatively: Use a solution-selling approach to uncover clients’ operational pain points and propose tailored offerings built on Spire’s weather forecasts, historical data, and climate analytics. Master the product: Develop deep expertise in Spire’s data products and platforms — their features, differentiation, and applications — to communicate compelling value to technical and executive audiences alike. Deliver winning proposals: Prepare and present persuasive sales presentations, proposals, and responses to tenders that clearly articulate Spire’s value proposition. Negotiate and close: Lead commercial negotiations on terms and pricing to reach mutually beneficial agreements and close deals reliably. Manage your pipeline: Maintain an accurate, up-to-date pipeline in our CRM, ensuring rigorous forecasting and timely follow-up on every lead and opportunity. Know the market: Track industry trends, competitive movements, and emerging opportunities across your regions to inform strategy and identify new areas for growth. Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with marketing, product, meteorology, and customer success teams to ensure client satisfaction and feed market insight back into product development. Basic Skills/Qualifications: 8+ years of experience in sales, business development, or account management, with a focus on selling data products, SaaS, or API-based solutions. A demonstrated track record of consistently meeting or exceeding sales targets and quotas. Strong understanding of the weather and climate industry, or deep experience selling digital transformation into data-driven sectors such as energy, maritime, aviation, agriculture, or logistics. A consultative, value-based selling style with excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills. Proven ability to build and maintain trusted client relationships across cultures, time zones, and seniority levels. Proficiency with modern sales tools (e.g., Salesforce or similar CRM, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Lusha). Self-motivated, results-oriented, and effective working independently in a remote, globally distributed team. Fluent in English; willingness to travel across the territory as needed. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience, preferably in a high-tech field. Preferred Skills/Qualifications: Additional language skills relevant to the EMEA or APAC regions. An existing network within meteorology, earth observation, or climate-tech communities. Experience selling to or partnering with government agencies, national met services, or large enterprises in regulated industries. Why Spire: Mission with impact: help organizations worldwide adapt to a changing climate using data collected from space. Real ownership: a large, high-potential territory with the autonomy to build it your way. Competitive compensation: base salary plus uncapped commission, and equity participation. Flexible, remote-first working within a collaborative, international team spanning four continents. Generous time off, local statutory benefits, and support for professional development. (Specific benefits vary by country of employment.) Access to US export-controlled software and/or technology may be required for this role. If needed, Spire will arrange the necessary licenses—this is not something candidates need to have before applying. Global Perks 🛰️ Name Your Satellite Program (NYSP) 🚀 Launch Attendance 🌴 Generous Time Off Policy 🎓 Education Assistance Program 🥰 Employee Assistance Program (EAP) 📈 Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP) 👣 Family Leave 💪 Fitness Reimbursement 🧡 Employee Referral Program 🍉 Healthy snacks & beverages in every office About Spire We improve life on Earth with data from space. Spire Global is a space-to-cloud analytics company that owns and operates the largest multi-purpose constellation of satellites. Its proprietary data and algorithms provide the most advanced maritime, aviation, and weather tracking in the world. In addition to its constellation, Spire’s data infrastructure includes a global ground station network and 24/7 operations that provide real-time global coverage of every point on Earth. Spire is Global and our success draws upon the diverse viewpoints, skills and experiences of our employees. new_matches.title: IT RESILIENCE MANAGER (M/V/X)
new_matches.description: Titel van de functie IT RESILIENCE MANAGER (M/V/X) Contracttype Onbepaalde duur Werkregime Voltijds WERKEN BIJ SIBELGA, DAT BOOST MIJN ENERGIE ! Sibelga is de distributienetbeheerder voor elektriciteit en aardgas in het Brussels Hoofdstedelijk Gewest. Wij zorgen voor een bedrijfszekere en duurzame energiebevoorrading van onze klanten. Wij streven in onze diensten vernieuwing en efficiëntie na. BIJ WELKE DIENST KOM JE TERECHT? De afdeling Digital Business Solutions (DBS) ondersteunt alle businessactiviteiten van Sibelga. Het zorgt ervoor dat Sibelga beschikt over performante processen en een autonoom IT-systeem dat deze processen ondersteunt en dat afgestemd is op de evoluerende behoeften en opkomende technologieën. Binnen de afdeling DBS is de eenheid IT Service Management - ERP - Tranest opgebouwd rond drie polen: Applicaties / Projecten Het ERP-team is verantwoordelijk voor de applicaties die essentieel zijn voor de interne werking van het bedrijf (Financiën, Logistiek, Human Resources), voornamelijk via de SAP-suite en aanverwante applicaties. Het zorgt voor de ontwikkeling ervan en biedt tweedelijnsondersteuning in geval van incidenten. Operationeel / Ondersteuning Het User Support & IMAC-team beheert eerstelijnsincidenten via de Service Desk, biedt directe ondersteuning aan gebruikers en zorgt voor de levering en het beheer van de IT-apparatuur die nodig is voor het dagelijks gebruik van de applicaties. Enabler / Governance De teams Transition Management en Test Management begeleiden de transversale processen voor de hele IT-afdeling. Ze implementeren methodologieën op het gebied van Change & Release Management, Configuration Management, Demand Management en Testing Management om een soepele overgang van ontwikkeling naar productie te garanderen. Binnen deze eenheid zijn we op zoek naar een IT Resilience Manager die rechtstreeks rapporteert aan de Unit Manager. JOUW JOB Als IT Resilience Manager speel je een cruciale rol in het waarborgen van de continuïteit van de bedrijfsactiviteiten en van een effectief beheer van incidenten. De rollen omvatten de coördinatie van ernstige incidenten, het beheer van problemen en het beheer van het rampherstelplan. Als coördinator van ernstige incidenten ben je verantwoordelijk voor het beheer en de coördinatie van ernstige IT-incidenten (gemiddeld 10 ernstige incidenten per jaar) die van invloed zijn op kritieke bedrijfsdiensten. Je zorgt voor effectieve communicatie tussen technische teams, zakelijke stakeholders en het management, terwijl je werk maakt van een snel herstel van de dienstverlening (incidentoplossing) en structurele aanpassingen (probleemoplossing). Wanneer een ernstig incident wordt gedetecteerd, start en beheer je het proces voor ernstige incidenten: Oprichting van een taskforce met de specifieke middelen die nodig zijn voor het onderzoek en de probleemoplossing. De taskforce aansturen om het incident zo snel mogelijk op te lossen. Communiceren met gebruikers en stakeholders via overeengekomen kanalen, zo snel mogelijk na de detectie van het incident en regelmatig tot het opgelost is. Als verantwoordelijke voor de verandering de veranderingen organiseren (beheer van veranderingsaanvragen – goedkeuring door de CAB – organisatie van de implementatie) Het incident documenteren volgens het overeengekomen proces, de analyse na het incident in goede banen leiden en voor de documentatie in ITSM-tools zorgen. De definitie en oplossing van het probleem aansturen. Als probleembeheerder ben je verantwoordelijk voor het beheer van het proces voor het beheer van problemen . Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp, de implementatie, het beheer en de voortdurende verbetering van het proces. Hoewel dit proces al vastligt, wordt het niet consistent toegepast binnen de organisatie. Daarom is een volledige evaluatie en herziening van het proces nodig om de afstemming, efficiëntie en consistentie te waarborgen. Als beheerder van het rampherstelplan ben je verantwoordelijk voor de planning, de implementatie en de handhaving van maatregelen die het herstel van de systemen en gegevens garanderen wanneer zich een ramp voordoet. Deze rol omvat de identificatie van potentiële risico's, de ontwikkeling van noodplannen en het testen van die plannen om hun effectiviteit te garanderen. Je werkt nauw samen met verschillende diensten om ervoor te zorgen dat de bedrijfsactiviteiten na een ramp snel en efficiënt kunnen worden hervat, waarbij downtime en/of gegevensverlies tot een minimum worden beperkt. JOUW PROFIEL Universitair diploma op masterniveau: burgerlijk of industrieel ingenieur of informatica/technologie. Opleiding in risicobeoordeling, crisisbeheer en noodplanning. Minimaal 5 tot 10 jaar ervaring in een belangrijke technische en operationele context of in een complexe IT-afdeling. Beroepservaring in het beheer van IT-activiteiten, met bijzondere aandacht voor incidentbeheer en veerkracht. Goed begrip van IT-infrastructuur, beveiligingsprotocollen en maatregelen voor gegevensback-up en -herstel. Vermogen om de verbanden tussen bedrijfsapplicaties en IT-infrastructuur te begrijpen. Sterke analytische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden. Goed ontwikkelde communicatieve en leiderschapsvaardigheden. Ervaring als IT-incidentmanager is een pluspunt. ONS AANBOD Een Top Employer-gecertificeerd bedrijf, dat het welzijn en de ontwikkeling van zijn medewerkers waardeert. Een betekenisvolle job, ten dienste van de stad en haar inwoners, in een sector die voortdurend evolueert. Een degelijke, voldoening gevende opleiding, plus doorgroeimogelijkheden. Een aantrekkelijk loonpakket met: Een representatievergoeding, eindejaarspremie en dubbel vakantiegeld, maaltijdcheques (€10/werkdag), ecocheques, individuele bonus en collectieve bonus. 20 wettelijke vakantiedagen en 13 compensatie-dagen. Hospitalisatieverzekering en ambulante zorgen voor het gezin, alsook een groepsverzekering en ongevallenverzekering privéleven. Een leasingwagen of mobiliteitsbudget. Korting van 30% op je energiefactuur. Smartphone met abonnement (ook voor privégebruik), laptop en terugbetaling internet. Sociaal fonds (tussenkomst in kosten voor bril, tandprothese, en andere medische kosten, Sinterklaas- & Kerstcheque, enz.). Locatie Locatie Werkhuizenkaai 16, 1000 Brussel

Coordinate with appointed Quantity Surveyors to verify completed works, quantities, variations and amounts claimed. Support value-engineering and cost-optimisation exercises while protecting the project’s quality and commercial objectives. Strong experience in procurement, tender preparation, tender evaluation, commercial negotiation and contract award. Practical knowledge of construction contract administration, including variations, claims and final accounts. Experience reviewing payment applications and administering payment-certification procedures. Strong understanding of Bills of Quantities, construction drawings, specifications and pricing documentation. Working knowledge of recognised forms of construction contract, such as FIDIC or equivalent forms. Strong financial, analytical and commercial judgement, with excellent attention to detail. Strong negotiation, written communication and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to prepare clear cost reports, tender adjudications and commercial recommendations. Ability to manage external Quantity Surveyors and other professional advisers effectively. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with relevant cost-management or project-reporting systems. Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities in a structured and accountable manner. High level of initiative and a proactive, methodical working style. Ability to collaborate effectively within a small, high-performing team environment. Experience working for a real estate developer, investment manager or development-management business would be considered an advantage. Knowledge of the Maltese construction market and local procurement practices would be considered an advantage.
